text.config.hungrycows.category.sheepSet:
These settings exist for parity as they refer to features that aren't adapted from Sheep themselves.
If set to "Enabled" Sheep use the feature with the same values set above for Cows.
text.config.hungrycows.option.sheepSetti:
If "Enabled" Sheep regain the same amount of health as Cows by eating a block of Grass.
If "Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regaining health at all.

If "Enabled" Sheep regain the same amount of health as Cows by being fed an item of the vanilla "sheep_food" Tag (by default, this is just Wheat).
If "Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regaining health at all.
Regrowing Wool from Being Fed Food (Sheep)

If "Enabled" Sheep can also regrow their wool for the same average amount of items of the vanilla "sheep_food" Tag (by default, this is just Wheat) as Cows need to regain Milkability.
If "Disabled" Sheep revert to the vanilla behavior of not regrowing Wool by being fed at all.
